The fix is incomplete. The round-4 vectors are fixed: an ordinary-commit rewrite, an uncommitted edit, a verdict flip and the plain --no-commit evil merge (N1) are now all rejected (repro-r5 tests 3-7). The new root-cause design is still bypassable. tools/gates/lib/rules.mjs:609-614 (checkWriteOnce) takes as the reference the blob of whichever commit appears FIRST in 'git log -m --full-history --diff-filter=A --reverse'. That order follows committer dates, which the committer chooses freely. It compares HEAD and the disk only with that blob (rules.mjs:633-636) and never looks at M events or at other adds. Bypass N4 (repro-r5 test 10): the runner commits the reviewer's genuine round-2 sidecar (FAIL/OPEN for High F-DG0-101), and the gate stays closed. The forger builds side commit S on the freeze commit, which predates the round evidence, with committer date 2001-01-01. S adds the round evidence with a forged PASS/CLOSED_VERIFIED sidecar and a meta.json whose outputs and tool_authored are re-pointed to the forged bytes. The forger merges S with a merge whose tree is the forgery; the gate record appears only in the merge. S is then the 'first add', so validateGate(current) returns [], and after approval validateGate(historical) and validatePipeline also return []. 'git diff <round commit> HEAD' plainly shows M on the sidecar. N4b (test 11): the same technique drops a committed round-1 High finding and flips the round-1 FAIL verdict to PASS. Test 9 is a control: with a current (non-back-dated) date for S, the rewrite is detected, so ordering alone decides. Both bypasses also pass on 53f5d176 (07-r5-repro-on-53f5d17.log). This contradicts D-021 ('every file ever added ... (merges included) must still hold ... the exact blob that first added it'). The disclosed residual covers only fabricating a new run directory, not rewriting a genuine one. Expected: every write-once path has exactly one distinct blob across ALL add/modify events against EVERY parent (git log -m --full-history --raw), with no M/T event anywhere, and HEAD and the disk equal that blob. The real DG0 history satisfies this today (190 paths, 0 with more than one blob, 0 merges, 0 back-dated commits; 14-history-feasibility.log), so the stricter rule would not block DG0. As defence in depth, the validator could also re-derive tool_authored from the transcript instead of trusting meta.tool_authored. The real DG0 evidence shows no sign of such tampering. This is a control weakness, not an observed forgery. Severity stays High and mandatory, as originally reported.

New d141d303, end to end with the real run-agent.sh and a stub claude in a disposable clone (08-runner-e2e.log, fake-claude-r5.py). A denied Write (tool_result is_error) plus content B from another writer gives tool_authored={}, and the record is not committed. Write followed by a Bash append gives tool_authored={}. Write followed by a successful Edit gives tool_authored with sha256 of the replayed 'A\nbar\n', committed. An Edit-only change to a pre-existing file gives tool_authored={}, which fails closed. The honest Write is tool_authored and committed. Validator side: rules.mjs:323-328 requires tool_authored[rel] to exist and equal outputs[rel]. repro-r5 test 12 rejects both a missing and a mismatched digest. D-021 and agent-protocol.md now describe the replay binding accurately. On 53f5d176 the round-4 runner e2e showed the denied-write case being bound (round-4 06-runner-e2e.log). Residual: the validator trusts meta.tool_authored rather than replaying the transcript itself. That matters only if meta.json can be rewritten, which is F-DG0-115.

New d141d303, end to end (08-runner-e2e.log). In FAKE_MODE=glob the agent Writes a file literally named 'x*' while tracked 'xy.md' is modified by someone else. The auto-commit contains only 'A .../x*' plus the run directory, and xy.md remains an uncommitted M, so it is not swept in. In FAKE_MODE=space, 'with space.json' is committed literally. With a pre-commit hook that exits 1, the runner prints 'FAILED to auto-commit ... NOT write-once yet' and exits 70. run-agent.sh:239-264 uses NUL-separated --pathspec-from-file with GIT_LITERAL_PATHSPECS=1, and tolerates only 'nothing to commit'. On 53f5d176 the round-4 e2e showed xy.md swept into the commit (round-4 06-runner-e2e.log).
